title: Action report (action-report.json)
description: The closing page: what works overall and how the site measures up against a list of standards.

strengths.description: Short statements of what works across the whole site.

benchmarks.description: Standards the site was checked against.

note.description: One sentence on the result. May refer to findings as [[key]].

keys.description: Optional. Keys of the findings this benchmark relates to. Each must exist in a dimension file.

rating_notes.description: Optional. Caveats about how the ratings were made.
